therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: COX-2 inhibition combined with cytotoxic chemotherapy
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: anti-inflammatory effects and enhanced chemotherapy efficacy
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: patients with newly-diagnosed metastatic Ewing's sarcoma family of tumors
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: occurrence of severe toxicity (grade 3+ infection or sensory neuropathy)

results.dose_information: celecoxib 250 mg/m2 PO BID, vinblastine 1 mg/m2 IV 3x/week, plus standard doses of cyclophosphamide, doxorubicin, etoposide, ifosfamide, vincristine
